project_name: Scooby no Beat - Link-in-Bio & Official Artist Hub
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / LUXURY NIGHTLIFE (Dark & Elegant Arrochadeira/Funk)

design_exploration_probabilities.name: Concept 1: Deep Obsidian & Neon Gold Paredão (Selected)
design_exploration_probabilities.description: Tactical dark theme with matte obsidian (#0A0A0E), radiant gold/champagne accents (#F5C518), Spotify emerald pulse (#1DB954), line-by-line staggered text reveals, and high-contrast glass link cards.

design_exploration_probabilities.name: Concept 2: Swiss Cyberpunk Stage Monolith
design_exploration_probabilities.description: Ultra-bold grid with high contrast black/white typography, kinetic ticker marquee, line borders, and heavy 900 weight condensed headings.

design_exploration_probabilities.name: Concept 3: Velvet Midnight Scrollytelling
design_exploration_probabilities.description: Rich dark violet/smoke gradient backgrounds, soft gold grain textures, ambient lighting, and interactive discography cards.

design_exploration_probabilities.name: Concept 4: Neon Club & Subwoofer Vibration
design_exploration_probabilities.description: High energy club strobe aesthetic with audio visualizer animations, equalizer bars, and bold neon cyan/magenta glows.

design_exploration_probabilities.name: Concept 5: Minimalist Editorial Presskit
design_exploration_probabilities.description: Clean dark editorial layout with high-ratio typography, monochrome imagery, and subtle hover lifts.

visual_enhancers.lenis_scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled globally via Lenis engine
visual_enhancers.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line stagger entrance using Framer Motion
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow kinetic editorial ribbon drifting infinitely at bottom/mid section with taglines
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 hover:border-amber-400/40 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.hero_card_3d: Subtle interactive mouse-follow tilt or float effect on artist photo card
visual_enhancers.favicon_mark: Custom inline SVG icon mark with paw + beat wave motif ('Cachorro na Voz')

key_sections.description: Sticky blurred header with SVG mark logo, 'CACHORRO NA VOZ' live badge, and admin access button
Featured artist photo with gold ring glow, verified check mark, handle @scoobynobeat, monthly listeners counter, and quick social links row
WhatsApp show booking banner ('CONTRATE PARA SHOWS') with direct message trigger
List of editable high-impact visual image cards (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Store, Latest Single)
Embedded official Spotify artist player for immediate streaming
Carousel/Grid of popular tracks ('Cheirinho de Perereca', 'Carro Bicho', 'Uma Hora Dessa', 'Pentão de Robocop', 'Mão no Joelhinho', 'Dia de Revoada')
Modal/Route at /admin with password authentication, CRUD manager for link cards, reordering, custom stats, and quick save

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure JavaScript/React (.js/.jsx) - DO NOT add TypeScript types or interfaces.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for high-end momentum feel.
Ensure dark mode by default with rich obsidian background (#0A0A0D) and gold/emerald highlights.
Include full CRUD for link-in-bio cards with local storage fallback so changes in /admin persist immediately.
Use Sonner for user notifications (e.g., link copied, admin login success, link saved).
Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in testing_attributes are present on interactive elements.
Ensure responsive layout optimization for mobile viewports while looking cinematic on desktop.
